title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Designating the Shanghai Maritime Court to Have Jurisdiction over Maritime Arbitration Judicial Review Cases Related to the Shanghai Sub-commission of the China Maritime Arbitration Commission
keywords_en: arbitration; related maritime arbitration judicial review cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Designating Shanghai Maritime Court to Have Jurisdiction over Judicial Review Cases concerning Maritime Arbitration Related to the Shanghai Sub-commission of the China Maritime Arbitration Commission

Fa [2005] No. 66

The High People's Courts of Liaoning Province, Shandong Province, Hubei Province, Zhejiang Province, Fujian Province, Guangdong Province, Hainan Province, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, Tianjin Municipality, and Shanghai Municipality, and all Maritime Courts:

Upon approval and registration by the Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Justice, the Shanghai Sub-commission of the China Maritime Arbitration Commission was formally established in Shanghai on January 8, 2003, and commenced accepting maritime arbitration cases. In order to clarify the jurisdictional division of relevant cases, strengthen judicial supervision over maritime arbitration, and facilitate litigation for the parties, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China, and the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, notice is given as follows:

Shanghai Maritime Court is designated to have jurisdiction over cases concerning the validity of maritime arbitration agreements involving the Shanghai Sub-commission of the China Maritime Arbitration Commission, as well as applications to set aside its maritime arbitration awards.

This notice is hereby given.

May 27, 2005
